subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should trusted HTTP callers be allowed to trigger the existing Gateway `update.run` self-update flow, and if yes should that happen through the opt-in admin HTTP RPC plugin rather than a new `/admin/update` endpoint?
rationale: The requested endpoint changes who can invoke host package-manager work and restart orchestration over HTTP; that security/product boundary cannot be decided by cleanup automation.

options.title: Expose through admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Approve a narrow `update.run` allowlist expansion in the existing default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin with docs and security tests for trusted private ingress only.

options.title: Expose via Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Allow or wrap `update.run` only with explicit private-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, failure-mode, and upgrade-proof requirements.

options.title: Design a separate endpoint
options.body: Sponsor a distinct endpoint only if maintainers want a request/response contract that differs materially from Gateway RPC.

recommendation.title: Expose through admin HTTP RPC
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow `update.run` allowlist expansion in the existing default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin with docs and security tests for trusted private ingress only.

likelyOwner.reason: He added the bundled admin HTTP RPC plugin and has recent ownership signals on gateway update/version surfaces.
